strings.name: Jean-Pascal Tricoire
strings.summary: Tricoire entered industry after electronics-engineering training and worked in Italy, China and South Africa. He led Schneider Electric’s executive operations from 2006 to 2023, developing energy management, industrial automation and digital businesses. After handing over the CEO role in 2023 he remained chairman. His career reflects industrial adaptation to globalization, data centres and lower-carbon technologies.
